blocks.text: A dash means the verb has no such participle: a perfective verb has no present participle, and an intransitive verb has no passive one.
A past passive participle declined in full — прочитанный
A present active participle declined in full — читающий

exercises.why: **читать → читающий** — present active participle: 3rd person plural without -т + -щ- + adjective ending.
**читать → читаемый** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).
**читать → читавший** — past active participle: past stem + -вш- (after a vowel) or -ш- (after a consonant) + adjective ending.
**читать → читанный** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.
